extracted.name: Crab stick salad
extracted.description: Make this quick and easy crab stick salad with refreshing cucumber and creamy mayonnaise for a barbecue or picnic
instruction_lines: Gently break the rice noodles up, then put them in a bowl and pour boiling water over them. Cover, then set aside for 15 minutes. Drain and cool.
Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, folding them gently together. Serve immediately or chill until needed. This recipe has been provided by Moje Gotowane and not been re-tested by us.
